source: tools/art/choir_heart.py (production art, M11 part H batch)
note: offsets in px from the piece's centre (screen (240, 70)), y down; additive sets are premultiplied on black (GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE)

pulse.alpha: the pulse 0..1 (smooth, <= 1 Hz, its peak on HEARTBEAT); 0 from K

centre_note: the Heart's centre = the core's place (the README's core row, screen (240, 150)): the heartbeat ring, the line and the spiral start here; the README's Movement row gives the piece's centre (240, 70)

membrane_frames.iris_note: the 0.8 s tell: frames 1-4 over its first 0.5 s, 5 held while it sings, the iris back 4..0 over 0.3 s after its last bullet; below half HP add 6

nodes.note: the node's centre on its half-wall's inner face (ArenaWalls), its strands into the wall

core.glow_note: choir-heart-core-glow frame = the 2.0 s heartbeat's phase x 8 (peak at 4)

walls.fps_note: frame = the 0.5 Hz breathe's phase x 8
walls.note: the strip's face column on the polyline; the tissue reaches 112 px outward (the wall's deepest: the hard 300 px corridor + 12 px breathe = 102 px)

pits.note: centred 8 px inside the wall's face (l: x - 8 ... the pod's mouth toward the corridor)

chain_note: a choir-heart-chain burst (10 frames, 12 fps) at each point at its time from K; debris rings of choir-heart-debris with the bursts; the act's flash at K + 3.5 s is the built one
spark: choir-heart-spark (4 frames, 16 fps) where a shot meets a closed mouth or the body
centre_tell: choir-heart-centre frame = the line's 0.8 s tell's progress x 6, held at 5 under the line
